problem: A school has 420 tablets. 10% are damaged and removed. The remaining tablets are divided between Room A and Room B in a ratio of 3:4. Room A receives 20% more tablets from a new shipment. Room B has 15% of its tablets replaced one-for-one, so its quantity does not change. Finally, 5% of the original 420 tablets are transferred from Room B to Room A.
turns: Oh I see, 420*0.1 = 42. So 42 tablets are damaged
